plan.scope: User-requested independent DP-D extension; original A/B/C/D/R and world-model results unchanged. Compact from-scratch Diffusion Policy style conditional action diffusion, not an exact reproduction of published benchmarks.
plan.visual_input: Initial full RGB only, frozen D seed7 XY estimator. No online true object state or future observations. Policy receives this initial estimate, robot proprioception, previous command and elapsed robot clock.
plan.demonstration_source: New privileged-state simulator expert trajectories from the existing physical controller; not action labels extracted from phone videos

evaluation.selection: all final EMA checkpoints; same reused development test scenes as original study; no best-seed selection

plan.action: Absolute next EE XYZ setpoint after original controller step-length limit plus commanded finger width, recorded before physics step
plan.padding: repeat first observation for history and final action for future; loss only on valid action indices; samples never cross episode boundaries
plan.normalization: training episodes only, per-dimension min/max to [-1,1], constant ranges given minimum scale 1e-6

model.type: compact conditional temporal U-Net with FiLM residual blocks
model.inference: DDIM eta=0, 20 evenly spaced denoising timesteps

training.validation: fixed 256 sequence-start samples, denoising loss and heldout action error; report only, never choose checkpoints

plan.fairness_limits: Same simulator physics, rendering and strict outcome scoring, but extra 128 robot demonstration trajectories and learned controller; not budget-matched auxiliary-supervision ablation. Same fixed D7 vision for all three policy training seeds. Clock-conditioned, initial-frame visual state policy; not end-to-end multi-frame image policy.
plan.status: plan fixed before new collection, policy training or results

provenance: New simulated expert commands; applicant videos only supplied upstream visual pretraining
retention: All scripted demonstrations retained regardless of success; no outcome-based filtering
